admin.name: Name
admin.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Give it to the user, who can change it later.
admin.removeConfirm: Remove the user {email}? Their memberships are removed too.
admin.forbidden: Only the super user can manage users.

reference.name: Name
reference.positionHint: Groups are shown in this order.

reference.directionHint: Decides whether amounts count as spending or income, whatever their sign.
reference.moveHint: Pick another category to move this sub-category.
